sections.advice: This Koyasan temple town → Kinokawa food stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Kinokawa food → Back to Hashimoto fuel is the reward section in Japan beyond Tokyo. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

places-church-of-st-george-of-the-former.story: 260 km from Gura Humorului to Gura Humorului, about 4 h 29 of riding.
